story_type: rescue swimmer lowered through the wake onto a fishing boat that keeps moving, basket hoist, hoist camera
hook: 80 miles out, the boat never stopped. The swimmer went anyway.
narration: Eighty miles out in the Gulf, a rescue swimmer dropped toward a boat that never stopped moving.
The man they came for was forty four, aboard a fishing boat southeast of Galveston.
The swimmer went down first, swinging out over the wake.
Crews ask a boat to hold a steady course into the wind, so the deck moves predictably under the helicopter.
Then the basket came down to the deck.
It came back up with the man inside.
Last, the swimmer rode the cable up and off the boat.
outcome: The man was delivered to a waiting ambulance at Scholes International Airport, in stable condition.
title: Swimmer dropped onto a moving boat
description:
On July 18, 2017, a Coast Guard helicopter crew medevaced a 44-year-old man from a fishing boat 80 miles southeast of Galveston, Texas. He was delivered to an ambulance at Scholes International Airport in stable condition.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Edward Wargo, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/538778
